title: KU researcher proposes techniques for communicators to recognize, avoid inherent biases in AI
summary_en: Mugur Geana, a professor of journalism & mass communications at KU, has contributed a chapter to a new book about the inherent biases in large language models. He proposes how communications professionals can recognize those biases and avoid repeating them in their own work.
title_cn: KU researcher proposes techniques for communicators to recognize, avoid inherent biases in AI
